final_coverage: Inactive raw-pane secondary click preserves active Composer target, keyboard focus, exact draft/selection value, and zero backend writes/submissions; primary mouse and touch still activate the clicked pane.
Cancelling an inactive-tab context menu returns to the original Composer focus and preserves its draft without writes.

Inactive TUI secondary input sends zero actual backend bytes. Active TUI secondary click still sends the original SGR press/release pair. A retained sink loses permission synchronously after active-pane change before a rebuilding frame.

At fixed 1200x800 logical size, DPR 1 to 2 keeps rows/columns stable while native pixel/cell metrics and runtime resize-event DPR/viewport agree. Ordinary output repaint does not fabricate resize events.
Rapid DPR 1 to 2 to 1 does not commit obsolete native metrics; releasing selection while a newer DPR is pending cannot commit the queued older DPR.

A tab menu captures its pane target before await; after that pane exits, Close pane cannot close the survivor, while explicit Close tab still closes the original surviving tab and preserves another tab.

A pane moved into another tab or a detached root reusing the old tab ID cannot be changed/closed through the stale menu. Original-member migration invalidates mode/recheck/action callbacks; natural exits remain distinct.

Existing Shell phase4, architecture budgets, Composer focus/submission, selection resize guard, replay viewport, divider keyboard, close protection, AI reconnect/Reader ownership, mobile modes and terminal input tests passed in the listed final invocations.

suggested_minimal_native_recheck.action: With pane A Blocks Composer focused and an unsent uniquely identifiable draft/selection, right-click inactive raw pane B. Then cancel any context menu and repeat primary mouse or trackpad-click activation on this Mac.
suggested_minimal_native_recheck.expected: Secondary interaction keeps A and its draft/focus; cancellation restores the trigger. Primary activation selects B while the A draft remains intact. Capture before/after target and input-owner states.

suggested_minimal_native_recheck.action: In an isolated local TUI fixture that logs mouse-report bytes, compare inactive B secondary click with explicitly active B secondary click.
suggested_minimal_native_recheck.expected: Inactive B receives zero manual bytes; active B retains its original press/release protocol. Keep server/fixture byte evidence separate from UI snapshots.

suggested_minimal_native_recheck.action: In a disposable local two-pane tab, open A context menu, let A naturally exit, then choose the old Close pane action; separately repeat with explicit Close tab while another tab remains.
suggested_minimal_native_recheck.expected: Old pane action cannot close survivor B. Explicit tab close acts only on the originally named surviving tab. Record PTY/session identities before and after.
